## Notes

Short, specific technical write-ups. Each note links to the repository holding the code it describes.

- [WSL 2 loses all networking under Check Point VPN hub mode](notes/wsl-2-check-point-vpn-hub-mode/) (2026-09-12): the Check Point Endpoint Security VPN in hub mode pulls locally attached networks into the tunnel, including the private Windows-to-WSL link. It installs two routes covering half the WSL subnet each, and Windows prefers the more specific match, so a /21 beats WSL's /20 and return traffic is swallowed. Names still resolve via DNS tunneling, which makes it look like a DNS fault. Not DNS, not MTU, and not fixable via mirrored mode. Fix: delete those routes (repo: https://github.com/mihai-valentin/wsl-checkpoint-vpn-fix).
